Callout.Name: Standoff - Suspect Inside
Callout.Message: Domestic incident escalated, one person inside refusing to come out.
Callout.Advisory: One male, no weapon confirmed, occupants out.

Script.Line: I have not done anything. I am not coming out for you.
You are not listening to me. None of you ever listen.
If I come out, what happens? Tell me what happens.
Alright. Alright. I am putting my hands on my head.

Stages.Stage: Second unit is on the street behind you.
He has his hands on his head.
He is in the car. Call finished.

Lines.Briefing: Nobody has been hurt yet and that is the whole job: talk him out.
Lines.Approach: He is in there on his own and he will not come out. Start talking - I am holding everybody back.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
